web.privacy: Files you select are read and stored only inside this browser.
web.soundHint: Tap the screen once to turn on sound
web.quota: The browser is out of storage space
web.storeFailed: Could not add the game file to the library ({reason}). It will only run this time
web.noStore: This browser cannot use storage (IndexedDB), so game files and saves will not be kept. If this is a private window, open the page in a normal window
web.storageNote:
Browser storage can be cleared by browser settings or storage cleanup.
Export important saves.
web.lib.empty: Your library is empty. Open a game file (.gba · .wgba · .wasm) and it goes on this shelf as a cartridge.
web.lib.noExport: Game files in the library can be opened only in this app.
web.lib.missing: The game was not found in the library. Please open the file again
web.lib.deleteText: {name} will be removed from this browser, along with its quick slots. Its save stays.
web.save.empty: No saves yet. Saving in a game keeps it here.
web.save.importText: {name} will be overwritten with the contents of {file}. The current save is lost, and a running game restarts.
web.save.deleteText: {name} will be deleted. This cannot be undone, so export it first.
web.save.deleteRunning: {name} will be deleted. The running game creates it again when it saves. This cannot be undone, so export it first.
web.saveFail.title: Could not keep the save
web.saveFail.text: {reason}. The game goes on, but the save may not be kept in this browser. Export the current save from the Saves menu.
web.wasmRom.title: A ROM is needed
web.wasmRom.text: {name} has no ROM inside. Choose the ROM (.gba) to use with this web build.
web.needsGlue: This wasm needs the .js built with it, so the web version cannot open it{why}
web.patch.intro: {name} has no ROM inside. Choose a ROM file you own to make the game, add it to your library and open it.
web.patch.overwrite: {name} in your library differs from what {patch} makes. Make it again and replace it? Saves stay.
web.dirInput.note: The stick follows your finger (no input in the middle); the D-pad uses the arm you press
web.pad.note: Shows on-screen buttons below the screen (or on both sides in landscape). They also work with a mouse
web.vibrate.note: A short vibration when an on-screen button is pressed (supported devices only)
web.wakeLock.note: Stops the screen from turning off while you play
web.pauseWhenHidden.note: Switching to another app or tab pauses the game and stores the save; it resumes when you come back
web.help.touch: On-screen buttons work with several fingers at once, and sliding on the D-pad changes direction. Games that use a mouse are played by touching the screen.
web.help.gamepad: Gamepads use the standard layout (press any button once to connect).
web.info.about: A GBA player that runs in the browser. .gba · .zip run on the mGBA core, and .wgba · .wasm on the built-in host. No ROMs, game files or official BIOS are included (mGBA's built-in HLE BIOS is used).
info.others: Tabler Icons (MIT), pako (MIT AND Zlib), Galmuri font (SIL OFL 1.1, © Lee Minseo).
host.embedFormat: This webGBA does not know this built-in ROM format (format {version} · method {method}). Reload the page to get the new version
patch.err.patchVersion: {name} uses a patch format this webGBA does not know (format {version}). Reload the page to get the new version
patch.err.romModified: {rom} is the same game ({title} · {code} · rev {revision}) but a modified ROM (SHA-1 {sha1}…). An original ROM without patches, cheats or edits is needed — usable ROMs: {need}
web.name.title: Name in the library
web.name.text: The game made from {patch} goes into your library under this name. Leave it empty to use the default name.
web.name.rule: Up to {max} characters · \ / : * ? " < > | are not allowed
web.name.bad: \ / : * ? " < > | and control characters are not allowed
web.name.long: Names can be up to {max} characters
web.name.takenText: {name} is already in your library. Overwriting replaces that game file and keeps using its save.
web.rename.text: Changes the display name of {name}. Its save carries on.
web.start.pickDrop: Select a game file or drop it here.
web.speed.note: Runs continuously at this speed (sound too). The top button switches to the next speed
web.gate.title: Install webGBA as an app
web.gate.lead: To keep your game files and saves safe on this device, webGBA runs only as an installed app.
web.gate.iosShare: Tap the Share button at the bottom (or top) of Safari.
web.gate.iosAdd: Choose 'Add to Home Screen', then tap 'Add'.
web.gate.iosOpen: Open webGBA from its icon on the Home Screen.
web.gate.openSafari: Open this address in Safari. Other browsers and in-app browsers cannot install it.
web.gate.openChrome: Open this address in Chrome. In-app browsers cannot install it.
web.gate.androidMenu: Tap the menu (⋮) at the top right.
web.gate.androidInstall: Choose 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen'.
web.gate.openApp: Open webGBA from the installed icon.
web.gate.desktopInstall: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar, or choose 'Install app' in the menu.
web.gate.desktopOpen: Play in the webGBA window that opens after installing.
web.gate.macDock: Choose File → 'Add to Dock' in the menu bar.
web.gate.unsupported: This browser cannot install apps. Please open this page in Chrome or Edge.
web.gate.installed: Installed. Open webGBA from your Home screen or app list.
web.quick.noteAuto: Slot 9 is for auto save only. It is overwritten every {n} min of play (Settings › Auto save).
web.quick.noteAutoOff: Slot 9 is for auto save only. Auto save is off now (Settings › Auto save).
web.quick.noteSav: Quick slots are kept apart from the in-game save (.sav). Loading one leaves the .sav as it is; it changes when you save in the game afterwards.
web.quick.noState: Quick slots are not available for this game
web.quick.overText: What you saved at {time} will be replaced.
web.quick.loadText: You go back to where you were at {time}. Progress since then is lost.
web.quick.loadedSave: {slot} was saved by another version: continuing on the field from that time
web.quick.loadFailed: Could not load. The slot may come from another game or core
web.autoSave.note: Overwrites quick slot 9, counting play time only
web.wgba.olderText: {name}: your library has {now}, and this file is the older {version}. Change to the older version? Saves and quick slots carry over
web.wgba.migrated: {name} {version} — took over the saves and quick slots of the old .wgba
web.wgba.moveFailed: Could not move the old saves, so the old entry was kept and the game was added separately
web.lib.pick: Tap a cartridge to take it out
web.wgba.olderOldText: {name}: your library has {now}, and this file is an old .wgba with no version. Change to the old file? Saves and quick slots carry over
web.wgba.migratedSave: {name} {version} — took over the save of the old .wgba
web.wgba.migratedStates: {name} {version} — took over the quick slots of the old .wgba
wgba.newer: This .wgba was made with a newer format. Reload the page to get the new version
